Save a journal-sized figure

Source: R/lcz_theme.R
lcz_save_figure.Rd

Writes PDF/SVG as vector (fonts embedded) and PNG/TIFF at 600 dpi, using Nature/Science column widths.

Usage

lcz_save_figure(
  plot,
  filename,
  width = c("double", "single"),
  height = NULL,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white",
  folder = "LCZ4r_output",
  lang = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot object.

filename

File name (extension decides the device).

width

"single" (89 mm), "double" (183 mm) or a number in mm.

height

Height in mm. Defaults to a 0.62 aspect ratio.

dpi

Raster resolution. Default 600.

bg

Background colour.

folder

Output folder.

lang

Language for the confirmation message.

quiet

Logical. Suppress the confirmation message.

Value

Invisibly, the file path.
